limitations: No raw campaign endpoints, solver logs or frozen QCQP coefficients in supplied archive; no new numerical residual evaluation was possible.
Audited certificates are validated as archived original-KKT audits with their input/start/endpoint/provenance bindings; this is not a fresh endpoint audit.
Internal success means application status code 0 or 1. Nonnegative application exit codes 2..6 are separately counted and never called success.
own_success_definition_note: The archived ipopt_own_success Boolean counts application code 0 only; the derived own-success-or-acceptable category counts 0 and 1. The 577 differences are definitional and do not alter any original certificate.
